Name: Sell Quality
Author: jasonmbrady
Description:
Allows you to sell the quality of an item down to the lower quality level. Useful for when you are turning it items for bundles/quests/artisan goods.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
While holding the object to downgrade, press the 'g' key. This will reduce the quality by 1 star-level and you will receive the difference in value between the old star value and the new star value in gold (for example, if you downgrade a silver star item worth 110g to a normal quality item worth 100g, you will receive 10g). This affects the entire stack of items you have selected, and multiplies the gold received by the number of items downgraded. 

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player. Untested in multiplayer
[/list]
